summary: Group types come from django-auth-ldap; LDAP User DN Template (for example uid=%(user)s,cn=users,cn=accounts,dc=example,dc=com) replaces user search when set, and LDAP Start TLS (off by default) upgrades a non-SSL connection to TLS.
